title: E.T. Whittaker's 1904-1905 papers showing scalar waves are feasible
summary: Salvatore Pais tells of E.T. Whittaker's 1904-1905 papers showing scalar waves are feasible, about 1904-1905 at England, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: fundamental papers of ET Whitaker 1904 1905 a English British mathematician by the name of ET Whitaker writes these two fundamental papers whereby he actually shows that scalar waves non herzian

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents for unusual craft designs, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a British mathematician named E.T. Whittaker wrote two key papers in 1904 and 1905. According to Pais, those papers showed that "scalar waves" are possible, meaning waves unlike ordinary radio waves. If true, it would give an old mathematical basis for exotic kinds of energy and propulsion.
